newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Mavesa Q4 net falls 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mavesa Q4 net falls 40 pct.

text.p: Net income 1.6 bln bolivars vs 4.0 bln
Net sales 34.9 bln bolivars vs 29.8 bln
Cost of sales 24.6 bln bolivars vs 19.7 bln
Net interest expense 1.4 bln bolivars vs 106.5 million gain
Notes: Results are inflation-adjusted in constant Oct 31 1996 bolivars.
Mavesa is a manufacturer of consumer brand and food and cleaning products.
Twenty common Mavesa shares are equivalent to one American Depository Receipt (ADR). A current offer to exchange these Mavesa pink sheet ADRs for freely tradable securities expires January 6.
Net income 14.0 bln bolivars vs 9.0 bln
Net sales 139.1 bln bolivars vs 117.3 bln
Cost of sales 95.7 bln bolivars vs 82 bln bolivars
Net interest expense 6.2 bln bolivars vs 3.7 bln bolivars
